title: EatStats
description: EatStats — client mod: shows other players’ gapple / notch / totem use above their head in PvP.
body:
# 🍎 EatStats: Professional PvP Tracker
EatStats is a high-performance client-side mod for Fabric, designed specifically for competitive PvP players. It tracks your opponents' golden apple consumption and totem usage in real-time, displaying precise statistics directly next to their nameplates.

### 🚀 Key Features:
- Precise Tracking : Separate counters for Golden Apples (Gapples) and Enchanted Golden Apples (Charms).
- Totem Pop Counter : Instantly captures and displays every totem pop from enemies in your vicinity.
- PvP-Oriented Reset : Apple counters automatically reset to zero the moment you deal damage to the target.
- Smart Detection : Tracks all players within a 40-block radius, even if they are behind you or out of your direct line of sight.
- Professional HUD : Clean, flat design without intrusive shadows or bulky boxes, blending perfectly with the vanilla interface.
### 🛠 Advanced Configuration (Key: "O"):
Fine-tune the HUD to your liking with our advanced settings menu (requires Cloth Config ):

- XYZ Precision Sliders : Move the HUD along three axes with instant live preview .
- Transparent Menu : The config background is translucent, allowing you to see the HUD move in real-time while adjusting sliders.
- Dynamic Scaling : Resize icons and text from 0.5x to 1.5x for optimal visibility.
- Flexible Positioning : Choose to display stats to the Right, Above, or Under the player's name.
### 🎨 Visual Excellence:
- Clean Colors : Uses soft Mint Green ( #98FF98 ) for apples and Pastel Red ( #FF6B6B ) for totems—no "eye-bleeding" neon palettes.
- No Rendering Bugs : Fixed common issues like double-shadow ghosting and black boxes around enchanted items.
- Depth Priority : The HUD stays on top of player models, ensuring you never lose track of vital information during intense fights.
### 📋 Requirements:
- Minecraft : 1.20.1
- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API
- Cloth Config API (Mandatory for the settings menu)
- Mod Menu (Recommended for easy access to configuration)
### ⌨️ Controls:
- O (default) — Open the Configuration & Calibration menu.
